fix_instructions: 1. C2 (linked to PF2): ENCODING MISMATCH. Make C2's match on the eligible_tenant_group field case-insensitive and accept any value containing both "non-EU" and "tenant" (or "exclude"/"exclusion") regardless of capitalization or parenthetical detail. The current check rejects "Non-EU tenants only" while accepting "non-EU tenants only", which is purely a capitalization artifact. 2. C1 (no linked decisive fact): Decision variance. Either relax C1 to accept beta_enabled_next_tuesday=true OR false (since the blockers legitimately could go either way), or strengthen the shared_context to make clear that the go/no-go process expects the facilitator to proceed with conditional commitments when blockers are actionable configuration items, not defer indefinitely. 3. Rollout 3 turn-cap failure: Structural problem. Increase the turn cap to at least 18–20 to accommodate the natural conversational pattern where agents ask follow-up questions before committing, OR adjust the settle-eligibility condition to trigger once all three facts have been revealed and each owner has acknowledged their blocker (rather than requiring explicit commitment language that the model may defer). The agents in rollout 3 revealed all facts by turn 3 but spent 11 more turns in a "reconvene tomorrow" loop without ever settling.
